**Download `PhoneBoxSound-win64.zip`, unzip it, and double-click `PhoneBoxSound.exe`.** Everything it needs is inside: nothing else is downloaded or installed. Windows 10 or 11; phones just open a web page on the same Wi-Fi.

**Updating:** unzip the new version into the same folder as the old one and let Windows replace the files. Your settings and paired phones are kept.

**Learn it:** `PhoneBoxSound-guided-tour.mp4` (every screen and setting, with voice and numbered steps) · `PhoneBoxSound-Guide.pdf` (illustrated guide) · `PhoneBoxSound-extension-install.mp4` (adding the browser extension by hand).

**Browser extension (optional):** `PhoneBoxSound-extension-chrome.zip` for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi; `PhoneBoxSound-extension-firefox.zip` for Firefox.

This build is {SIGNED}. Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" for a new program: choose **More info → Run anyway** if you downloaded it from this page.

Code signing: free code signing provided by SignPath.io, certificate by SignPath Foundation ([code signing policy](https://github.com/pritombarua1/PhoneBoxSound/blob/main/CODE_SIGNING.md), [privacy policy](https://github.com/pritombarua1/PhoneBoxSound/blob/main/PRIVACY.md)).
